scope: Selected first-edition breadth and reference-function benchmarks

benchmarks.title: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics
benchmarks.accessible_extent: Official indexed publisher/help evidence recorded in the 7 September planning notes. Both direct routes returned 403 on 9 September; no fresh full contents/body reading is claimed.
benchmarks.required_crosswalk: The maintained reference-entry fields, subject and task lookup, assumptions, variants, uncertainty and full-treatment destinations in APP-01 through APP-06 and PUB-01.

benchmarks.title: The Handbook of Rationality
benchmarks.accessible_extent: All three publisher contents images, printed v-vii; exact chapter exports 2.1, 8.5 and 9.2 held. Later source notes establish completed selected writing/reading for 2.1 and 9.2. MIT Direct full book route returned 403 on 9 September.
introductory_subsections: Contours of the Concept of Rationality
Normative and Descriptive Theories of Rationality
Rationality in a Process-Oriented and an Output-Oriented Perspective
benchmarks.paratext_disposition: Four part and fifteen section headings preserve organization. Preface ix, Overview xi, Contributors 807, Name Index 811 and Subject Index 843 are source apparatus; the introductory framework's substantive distinctions remain included. Index entries are not independently expanded into whole-source obligations.
benchmarks.page_rule: Contents start pages are exact locators. A following start page supplies only an upper boundary for a chapter slot, not a verified final body page.

benchmarks.title: The Oxford Handbook of Thinking and Reasoning
benchmarks.edition: Oxford University Press 2012; online chapter records dated 21 November 2012 where verified
benchmarks.accessible_extent: Complete official contents chapters 1-40. Individual publisher identities/abstracts are recorded separately. No complete chapter body was read in this mapping block.
benchmarks.paratext_disposition: Copyright, editor biographies, preface, contributors and index preserve source identity and organization without becoming new empirical findings. The numbered Reader's Guide remains a substantive comparison unit.
benchmarks.page_rule: Only individually verified publisher page ranges are asserted. Missing ranges remain null; neighboring chapter starts are not silently substituted.

benchmarks.scope_decision: Exact editions, chapters, manifestations and accessible extents come from the source-specific shards. A series title is never a substitute for its enumerated volumes. The remaining original sources remain mandatory through their own historical records even when not named in this benchmark subset.

title_transcription: Plain-text punctuation is normalized in the working TSV; the retained publisher contents and exact chapter identities govern source wording.
